data.one_liner: Draw and interact with customizable flow chart diagrams and dashboards.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to draw customizable flow chart diagrams with shapes like diamonds, rectangles, ovals, storage, and parallelograms. Dashboards support saving and loading, interactive element connections, and zooming.
use_when: You need to display interactive flow charts or diagrams in your app
Users need to connect, resize, or create custom flowchart elements
You want to save and load flowchart state from disk
avoid_when: You are building standard statistical data charts like bar, line, or pie charts
You need complex automated graph layout algorithms rather than manual positioning
strengths: Supports multiple element shapes and customizable styles
Includes built-in saving and loading of dashboards to JSON
Supports custom element data types via DataSerializer
weaknesses: Limited to flow charts and node diagrams rather than analytical charts
